verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a built-in AI assistant inside Shopify that users can delegate tasks to. What it does cover is adjacent and does not count: MCP servers and UCP let external AI agents connect (building blocks), the AI Toolkit plugs into third-party coding tools, "Design fast with AI" is a vague theme-design claim, and "sell in AI chats" is a sales channel.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
